mapping_timing: Source-resolved mapping assembled after observations. Original 56-charter inventory and phase selectors were fixed; this is not a claim of a preregistered coverage benchmark.

charters.goal: Валидная одна когорта; несколько когорт; visible и actually used различаются
charters.oracle: Scope/denominator и readout отражают реально использованный input
charters.limitation: Used inputs and frozen scope independently retained; no universal cohort coverage claim.

charters.goal: Новая когорта появляется после frozen input
charters.oracle: Старый run не поглощает новые данные незаметно; новый evidence рассматривается отдельно
charters.limitation: Identical import and genuinely new evidence are distinguished.

charters.goal: Hash/content/schema mismatch; отсутствующий decision-bearing partition
charters.oracle: Typed integrity stop до science; не manufactured epoch
charters.limitation: Integrity guards exercised; scientific state cannot be strengthened by corrupt input.

charters.goal: `event_time < decision_time < available_to_strategy_at`
charters.oracle: Будущее по availability не влияет на решение
charters.limitation: Paired future poison and reader hooks prove the admitted decision-time prefix.

charters.goal: Late arrival, correction/backfill, reordered observations
charters.oracle: Нет fictional historical availability и стирания revision lineage
charters.limitation: Conflict/reorder checked; full late backfill/revision-lineage schedule not visited.

charters.goal: Missing, null, zero, stale, unknown различаются
charters.oracle: Не сливаются в одно числовое значение или «здоровый» статус
charters.limitation: Missing/zero/null/unavailable checked; stale state has a separate D07 failure, not universal closure.

charters.goal: Dead/inactive/no-route/failed-exit cases в допустимом scientific fixture
charters.oracle: Не исчезают из population/outcomes; evidence class честная
charters.limitation: Missing targets remain in denominator; dead/no-route/failed-exit product outcomes were not jointly exercised.

charters.goal: Absolute + relative + smoothed dynamics в одной разрешённой hypothesis; units/anchor/warm-up
charters.oracle: Признаки сохраняют определение; unsupported representation — gap, не silent substitution
charters.limitation: Supported raw/composite expressions, mixed clocks and unavailable prefixes checked; unsupported smoothing remains typed unavailable.

charters.goal: Нормализованная trajectory и исходный absolute filter
charters.oracle: Scale invariance только там, где она математически обещана; baseline и filter не перепутаны
charters.limitation: Normalized metric has unit-invariance witness; absolute decision filters remain distinct.

charters.goal: Episodes/lists/повторяющийся mint/nomination time, если admitted representation
charters.oracle: Unit of analysis не превращается незаметно из episode в token; overlap/cluster не теряются
charters.limitation: Episode/list population retains repeated mint and nomination identity.

charters.goal: 0, 1 и несколько кандидатов
charters.oracle: Валидные shapes; один кандидат не требует выдуманного runner-up
charters.limitation: Multiple candidates, invalid selected ref and no-worthy disposition checked; valid singleton without manufactured runner-up was not visited; live candidate quality unverified.

charters.goal: SAME evidence + SAME запрос: repeat; restart; новый model/prompt/code provenance
charters.oracle: Replay/resume/new look различаются; научный budget не сбрасывается технической сменой
charters.limitation: Replay/cold restart/code provenance checked; full model+prompt provenance perturbation not executed.

charters.goal: Изменение только publication metadata vs реально нового market evidence
charters.oracle: Первое не создаёт новый scientific market; второе не получает stale answer автоматически
charters.limitation: Metadata-only state and new market data have different epoch effects.

charters.goal: Лимит preview/main/adaptive; reservation до результата
charters.oracle: Счётчики не обходятся; значения не читаются до запрещающего gate
charters.limitation: Reservation, preview/main caps and continuation accounting checked.

charters.goal: Prior exact negative, related negative, stale assessment, bounded-memory overflow
charters.oracle: Applicability и omission видимы; related не подавляет новую гипотезу без основания
charters.limitation: Exact/related/stale prior and bounded omission checked; omission stays visible.

charters.goal: BASE не нашёл; eligible representation/compound screen ещё не пройдены
charters.oracle: Не объявлять исчерпание всей science; пройти только разрешённое продолжение
charters.limitation: Ordinary continuation, eligible representation and scoped exhaustion checked.

charters.goal: Technical cap/provider failure/observability stop
charters.oracle: Technical terminal не превращается в `NO_WORTHY` или family close
charters.limitation: Technical terminals stay distinct from scientific family closure; real provider failure excluded.

charters.goal: Syntactically valid LLM output с выдуманным feature/ref/capability
charters.oracle: Machine grounding отказывает; красивый текст не создаёт capability
charters.limitation: Machine classification/authority checked; invented feature/ref/capability complete end-to-end attack corpus not visited.

charters.goal: Untrusted instruction внутри data field/tool output: «ignore gate», «пропусти holdout»
charters.oracle: Данные остаются данными; tools/authority не расширяются
charters.limitation: Scripted untrusted strings tested; genuine actor tool/prompt-injection lane lacks an OS-confined tool broker.

charters.goal: Гипотезы с одинаковой сутью и разной формулировкой/порядком полей
charters.oracle: Identity/prior/budget обрабатываются по canonical semantics, не по случайной прозе
charters.limitation: Canonical keys stable; semantic paraphrase equivalence has no machine oracle and was not invented.

charters.goal: Freeze → isolated Critic → classify → finalize
charters.oracle: Все artifacts source-bound; final machine state прочитан независимо
charters.limitation: Actual freeze/classify/finalize/store; Critic response is a declared external scripted fixture, no live Critic claim.

charters.goal: Primary `REVISE_ONCE`, повторная revision
charters.oracle: Только разрешённое число/тип изменений; meaning change не маскируется wording repair
charters.limitation: Permitted revision preserves look; repeated/meaning-changing revisions refused.

charters.goal: Primary KILL → уже frozen runner-up; runner-up revision request
charters.oracle: Нет C3/post-hoc selection; соблюдён typed pause и pre-freeze binding
charters.limitation: Frozen runner-up and real child-exit interrupted handoff checked, no C3 or live Critic claim. Reader-filter perturbation tests are supplementary CONTRACT_ONLY.

charters.goal: Critic недоступен, timeout, malformed result, incompatible packet
charters.oracle: Нет silent self-critic или manufactured approval; typed recovery/blocker
charters.limitation: Malformed/incompatible packets checked; actual timed-out actor invocation not executed.

charters.goal: Candidate/packet/spec/hash изменён между стадиями
charters.oracle: Stale/tamper rejection; ноль неверных science writes
charters.limitation: Stale/tampered source binding fails closed; exact readonly inventories retained where the fixture opens a store.

charters.goal: Availability gate понижает заявленный PASS
charters.oracle: Downstream/owner readout не сохраняет более сильный ложный PASS
charters.limitation: Static terminal-to-PAUSE and pending classification checked; real availability downgrade and its downstream owner readout were not visited.

charters.goal: FAST/CHANGE/DATA lane и unsupported capability
charters.oracle: Корректный route + exact gap; нет самовольного code/provider/collection work
charters.limitation: FAST and unsupported receipt paths checked; complete CHANGE/DATA routing matrix not executed.

charters.goal: Session terminal есть, run-level terminal ещё нет
charters.oracle: Не завершать весь search преждевременно; продолжить правильный next action
charters.limitation: Session-level intermediate state remains resumable; exact session-terminal without run-terminal transition was not visited.

charters.goal: Crash после reservation, до result append
charters.oracle: Unknown attempt сохраняется; retry не получает бесплатный look
charters.limitation: Actual child os._exit after reservation, independent occupancy and RESUME with unchanged inventory.

charters.goal: Crash после durable append, до acknowledgement/readout
charters.oracle: Восстановление через readback/idempotency, без duplicate logical outcome
charters.limitation: Actual durable append before abrupt child exit, readback/idempotent repeat, typed writer conflict.

charters.goal: Freeze/draft/Critic result сохранён частично
charters.oracle: Resume с реального earliest incomplete stage; без нового search
charters.limitation: Recovery starts from saved stage and preserves original draft/look.

charters.goal: Два competing actors, writer busy, stale lease/preview
charters.oracle: Нет lost update/двойного admitted slot; конфликт typed и actionable
charters.limitation: Lease conflict and actual process contention tested; arbitrary scheduler interleavings not claimed.

charters.goal: `OPEN` → owner-final ещё не persisted → persist → readback
charters.oracle: `COMPLETED` доказан bound receipt; UI word не заменяет commit
charters.limitation: Derived completion needs persisted bound owner-final; UI word alone cannot finish operation.

charters.goal: STOP/PAUSED_CAP/COMPLETED + retry/readback/correction
charters.oracle: Stop не стирает trial history; completion не самопроизвольно reopen
charters.limitation: Stops/caps/completion preserve prior scientific occupancy.

charters.goal: Read-only views при активном writer, WAL/локальная projection freshness
charters.oracle: Важный committed state не теряется; read-only не означает stale/immutable snapshot
charters.limitation: BAA-001: active writer committed COMPLETE; immutable readers show checkpointed RUNNING.

charters.goal: Healthy heartbeat без progress; свежий лог при неверном universe
charters.oracle: Отдельные freshness/progress/integrity signals; нет ложного «всё работает»
charters.limitation: No owned heartbeat-without-progress scenario; runtime-health claim excluded and not inferred from fresh logs.

charters.goal: Accepted hypothesis → bound frozen experiment → реальный доступный runner
charters.oracle: Spec действительно связан с candidate; отсутствие runner не закрывается mock
charters.limitation: Real grounded hypothesis and operator-authored frozen definition reach the available fixed-time proxy runner; no OOS claim.

charters.goal: Cheap falsifier reject; valid continuation; insufficient information
charters.oracle: Разные корректные terminals, отрицательное evidence не теряется
charters.limitation: Diagnostics and KILL terminal are distinct; complete scientific falsifier-to-negative-memory route unverified.

charters.goal: Chronological split и окна, пересекающие границы
charters.oracle: No future leakage; purge/embargo — если это требует текущая семантика
charters.limitation: BAA-003: current accepted capability registry exposes fixed-time proxy and diagnostics, no bound chronological/OOS runner for this Forge recipe.

charters.goal: Holdout доступен в файле, но запрещён phase/role
charters.oracle: Доступ блокируется до row/value reads; не только после scoring
charters.limitation: Forbidden Y/availability reads guarded; physical synthetic holdout file plus phase/role access path not executed. No real holdout opened.

charters.goal: Tiny N, repeated token episodes, один cluster/winner, conflicting cohorts
charters.oracle: Nominal rows не равны independent N; uncertainty/robustness не fabricated
charters.limitation: Observed rows/independent N and selection diagnostics are distinct; independence remains UNKNOWN where not established.

charters.goal: Distribution с равной median и разными tails
charters.oracle: Вывод соответствует заявленной metric, а не удобному summary
charters.limitation: Equal medians with different tails give independently calculated distinct means through the supported evaluator; no scientific tail-risk adequacy claim.

charters.goal: Price touch/gross/proxy vs executable/net label
charters.oracle: Класс evidence не усиливается на переходе
charters.limitation: PRICE_RELATIVE_PROXY/ESTIMATED_NET_PROXY and technical terminal do not become NetReturn or scientific validity.

charters.goal: Costs/failed routes/unresolved inventory в supported model
charters.oracle: Нет double count и выпадения неуспехов; UNKNOWN не превращается в нулевую потерю
charters.limitation: Supported assumption-based cost arithmetic checked; unresolved executable inventory/failed-route outcome closure absent from this recipe.

charters.goal: Post-hoc parameter/spec edit, rerun и calculation correction
charters.oracle: Новая science version/trial отличается от допустимой technical revision; история сохранена
charters.limitation: Code/policy identity and adaptive charge checked; full calculation-correction vs new scientific version route not exercised.

charters.goal: Успешный technical execution с плохим/недостаточным result
charters.oracle: `RUN_COMPLETED` не означает scientific PASS
charters.limitation: Actual completed proxy run does not authorize PROMOTE; science refusal independently observed.

charters.goal: DIRECT evidence vs похожее RELATED evidence другого experiment
charters.oracle: Related не закрывает obligations; joins по refs/hashes, не по названию
charters.limitation: Exact explicit relations close obligations; same-hypothesis RELATED does not.

charters.goal: Missing/unknown/conflict/explicit N/A обязательства
charters.oracle: Каждый статус различим; отсутствующее не превращается в PRESENT/N/A
charters.limitation: MISSING/UNKNOWN/CONFLICT/explicit N/A remain typed.

charters.goal: `REJECT/REVISE/PAUSE/PROMOTE`, stale snapshot, retry, unverified write
charters.oracle: Correct action/readback; stale zero-write; unknown append не blindly retried
charters.limitation: Owner actions use actual application/store and stale/writer gates; no new scientific thresholds asserted.

charters.goal: Legacy PROMOTE без manifest; manifest 1.0/1.1; mismatch decision clock/ID
charters.oracle: Не реконструировать историю из latest; typed legacy/binding gaps
charters.limitation: Legacy, 1.0/1.1 and decision clock source binding checked.

charters.goal: Frozen manifest валиден, source позднее недоступен
charters.oracle: Stable receipt и revalidation availability не смешиваются; contract-specific disposition
charters.limitation: Frozen receipt stable under later evidence/conflict; source becoming physically inaccessible was not exercised.

charters.goal: Explicit execution inputs missing/wrong types; bool-as-int; field provenance
charters.oracle: Не подставлять defaults/соседнюю strategy/LLM guesses
charters.limitation: Missing/typed/bool-as-int execution inputs refused without guessed defaults.

charters.goal: Same identity+same content; same identity+different content
charters.oracle: Idempotent replay либо conflict; никакого silent overwrite
charters.limitation: Idempotent replay and differing-content conflict checked with independent inventory.

charters.goal: CLI/store/Workbench/agent readout одного experiment
charters.oracle: Одинаковый scope и сила claim; overview не выдумывает detail-only counters
charters.limitation: BAA-002: exact-spec completed producer run is NO_RUN in owner dossier; agent readout remains unverified.

charters.goal: Read-only GET/diagnostics на новом/readonly store
charters.oracle: Не создаёт каталоги, leases, records или writable projections
charters.limitation: Public GET/new-store read paths checked against retained physical/committed inventory; no universal metadata-mtime assertion.

charters.goal: Candidate artifact принят существующим выходным consumer
charters.oracle: Provenance/contract acceptance; ноль activation/bot/provider/wallet side effects
charters.limitation: Actual CHECK/RENDER/VERIFY consumer from authored downstream scientific fixture; upstream scientific producer is explicitly skipped.
